name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Judge blocks Trump's latest effort to narrow birthright citizenship
changes.summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked a Trump executive order that would prevent certain people from automatically becoming U.S. citizens at birth.

changes.title: States Sue Over Move to End to Federal Funds for Transgender Youth for Transition Care
changes.summary: The Trump administration wants to bar Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program from paying for gender-transition medication and surgery for transgender adolescents.

changes.title: Judge Blocks Trump’s Second Try to Restrict Birthright Citizenship
changes.summary: The ruling raised concerns that babies already defined as citizens by the Supreme Court could have their citizenship revoked under an order the president signed in August.

changes.title: Morning News Brief
changes.summary: Exodus of experienced military leadership continues in the Pentagon, Trump touts Venezuela oil deal as critics question legality, the jury is deadlocked in the trial of Lindsay Clancy.

changes.title: Ex-National Security Council director on administration's plan for Venezuela oil
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks former Obama administration official Benjamin Gedan {guh-DAN} about the viability of the Trump administration's plan for Venezuelan oil.

changes.title: Stephen A. Smith on Trump, Democrats and the politics of chaos
changes.summary: Stephen A. Smith on Trump, Democrats and the politics of chaos lead image.

changes.title: Hegseth favors Sean Parnell for Army secretary, sources say, but it's unclear who's on Trump's short list
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has told people close to him that Sean Parnell would be his top choice for secretary of the Army, several senior officials told CBS News.

changes.title: Pete Hegseth Faces Growing Criticism as War With Iran Rolls On
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is facing growing criticism from some Republicans, with a key senator now calling on President Donald Trump to replace him. changes.title: Trump admin threatens to cut Smithsonian support in latest claim of ideological bias
changes.summary: The Trump administration is threatening to withdraw support for the Smithsonian Institution, accusing its leadership of presenting a “radical ideology” that weakens “shared American identity” in the latest effort to pressure the institution to change its presentations and practices.

changes.title: Trump promises to campaign for Republicans and says they have a winning midterm message
changes.summary: Voters' dim views of the economy and the war in Iran have put Republicans in a tough spot as the midterm election season enters its final stretch.
